t: What he said on seeing a new moon
a: اللَّهُمَّ أَهْلِلْهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالإِسْلاَمِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
p: Allāhumma ahlilhu ʿalaynā bi-l-yumni wa-l-īmāni wa-s-salāmati wa-l-islām. Rabbī wa rabbuka-Llāh
m: O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and safety and submission. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.
